lemmas.lemma: aldri så galt at det ikke er godt for noe
lemmas.primary_translation: nothing is so bad that it cannot be good for something

word_forms.word_form: aldri så galt at det ikke er godt for noe

definitions.text: en hendelse som bare ser uheldig ut, kan likevel føre med seg noe positivt
definitions.translation: an event that merely appears unfortunate can nevertheless lead to something positive (lit. never so bad that it is not good for something)
